text: Product requirements, in [`docs/PRD.md`](../docs/PRD.md): the problem, who Invariant serves, five goals, the non-goals, who builds what, the trusted base, requirements with their status, measures taken from the first three live issues, and the slices after 6. Ratified with its four recommendations. The slices after self-hosting are code you can ship, then crash and concurrency safety, then going public. Changes to the trusted base land by pull request, and @gitdek merges them once CI passes. The factory records its numbers. The goals, the non-goals and the split of who builds what stand as written.
